benefits.title: Hilton Honors Gold status

benefits.title: Leaders Club Sterling status
benefits.detail: Enroll for complimentary Leaders Club Sterling status with The Leading Hotels of the World. Program/property terms and availability apply.

benefits.title: Rental privileges — Avis
benefits.detail: Eligible cardmember enrollment activates partner rental privileges under Avis, Hertz or National terms; qualifying bookings, location, vehicle and availability restrictions apply. Confirm the partner account’s actual enrolled tier before travel.

benefits.title: Rental privileges — Hertz
benefits.detail: Eligible cardmember enrollment activates partner rental privileges under Avis, Hertz or National terms; qualifying bookings, location, vehicle and availability restrictions apply. Confirm the partner account’s actual enrolled tier before travel.

benefits.title: Rental privileges — National
benefits.detail: Eligible cardmember enrollment activates partner rental privileges under Avis, Hertz or National terms; qualifying bookings, location, vehicle and availability restrictions apply. Confirm the partner account’s actual enrolled tier before travel.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection

Companion cards are not equivalent to paid Additional Platinum cards.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.detail: American Express charges no foreign transaction fee on purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Global Dining Access by Resy
benefits.detail: Access to hard-to-get reservations at participating restaurants, Priority Notify and a Resy profile badge when you add the card to Resy.

benefits.title: Premium Global Assist Hotline
benefits.detail: 24-hour emergency assistance when travelling more than 100 miles from home. Certain approved emergency medical evacuation/transport services may be arranged without charge under Premium Global Assist terms. Third-party service costs generally remain yours unless expressly covered; contact Amex for advance approval. This is not general emergency medical insurance.

benefits.title: Cruise Privileges Program
benefits.detail: Eligible cruise bookings through participating Amex Travel services can receive specified shipboard credits/amenities; cruise line, itinerary, cabin and booking rules apply. This is booking access, not an elite status grant.

benefits.title: Delta Sky Club — 10 annual visits
benefits.detail: US eligible basic/paid Additional Platinum: 10 visits each February 1–January 31, each covering eligible entries within 24 hours. Same-day Delta-operated flight or Delta-marketed WestJet (006 ticket); Main Basic/equivalent excluded. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks unlimited visits through January 31 of the year after the following year. After allotment, US$50/visit; guests US$50/person, eligible itinerary required. Three-hour departure rule; issuer/Delta layover timing differs—verify before a long connection.

benefits.title: Centurion & Sidecar lounges
benefits.detail: Eligible Platinum, matching confirmed same-day boarding pass and ID; Centurion entry within three hours of departure, connecting entry within five hours, no arrival-only access. Sidecar entry within 90 minutes. US Platinum guests generally US$50/adult and US$30/age 2–17 at US locations; under 2 free. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks up to two complimentary guests through January 31 after the following year. Location fees differ; guests must share the flight; capacity terms apply.

benefits.title: Unlock unlimited Delta Sky Club visits
benefits.detail: US$75,000 eligible calendar-year card-account spend unlocks unlimited eligible Delta Sky Club visits for the rest of the current Medallion Year and the following Medallion Year; itinerary, ticket and guest rules remain. This is lounge access, not airline elite status.

benefits.title: Unlock complimentary Centurion guests
benefits.detail: US$75,000 eligible calendar-year account spend unlocks up to two complimentary guests per eligible Centurion visit, through January 31 of the year after the following year. Same-flight, age, location, Sidecar and capacity rules remain.

benefits.title: 35% airline Pay with Points rebate
benefits.detail: Use Pay with Points through Amex Travel for eligible flights on the one selected qualifying airline: 35% of redeemed points returned, up to one million points/calendar year. Redemption benefit, not extra purchase rewards or automatic 1.54-cent valuation on all flights.

benefits.title: 2X key business & large purchases
benefits.detail: 2X on eligible US construction/hardware, electronic-goods retailers, software/cloud providers and shipping, plus eligible purchases of US$5,000 or more; combined US$2 million/calendar-year cap. Only highest eligible bonus applies.

benefits.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
benefits.detail: Eligible Amex Travel bookings include breakfast for two, property-specific credit, guaranteed 4pm checkout and upgrades/noon check-in when available; package per stay with anti-splitting restrictions. Marketed average value is not a cash credit.

benefits.title: The Hotel Collection
benefits.detail: Eligible prepaid bookings of two or more consecutive nights through Amex Travel may include US$100 property credit and room upgrade when available. Property credit is per stay and separate from the statement lodging-credit cap.

benefits.title: ZO membership event-space and Dining Club credit
benefits.detail: Complimentary American Express ZO Membership from Tishman Speyer includes up to US$500 in statement credits each calendar year toward ZO event-space bookings and/or a Dining Club membership.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation & interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Covered round-trip cancellation/interruption: up to US$10,000/trip and US$20,000/card/12 months for each coverage, excess of other benefits. Full common-carrier transport paid with card/allowed points or vouchers; only defined causes qualify, not any reason. Pre-existing conditions and supplier insolvency excluded. Notify insurer and supplier within required times; insurer notice 60 days, proof 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered round trip delayed more than 6 hours: up to US$500/trip, two claims/card/12 months, excess of other benefits. Pay full common-carrier transport with the card/allowed points or vouchers and additional expenses with that card. Weather, equipment failure, hijacking/terrorism or lost travel documents may qualify; known delays excluded. Notify within 60 days; proof within 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered loss/theft/damage: carry-on up to US$3,000, checked US$2,000, high-risk items US$1,000; combined US$3,000/person/trip. NY US$2,000/bag and US$10,000/trip aggregate. Full common-carrier fare paid with card/eligible Amex rewards; other-program redemptions excluded. Excess of other cover; eligible family covered. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.detail: Prior month's eligible wireless bill paid with card: covered theft/damage including cracked screens, up to US$800/claim after US$50 deductible, two claims/account/12 months; excess of other insurance. Lost/mysteriously disappeared phones and cosmetic damage excluded. Theft police report within 48 hours; notify claim within 90 days/as soon as reasonably possible, written proof within 120 days.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible card-paid new purchases: 90 days against theft/accidental damage/loss; up to US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Natural-disaster sublimit US$500/event. Only eligible card payment is covered; item/event exclusions apply. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Extends eligible original manufacturer warranties of five years or less by up to one year, after the original warranty/service contract. Warranty must be valid in the US/DC/territories; up to eligible card payment, US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Exclusions apply; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible and normally submit proof within 60 days.

benefits.title: Car rental loss & damage insurance
benefits.detail: Secondary theft/damage cover up to US$75,000/rental agreement, first 30 consecutive days. Reserve/pay the entire rental with the eligible card and decline CDW/similar cover. Australia, Italy, New Zealand, peer-to-peer rentals and excluded vehicles are not covered; no liability insurance. State provisions vary; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible, proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Return protection
benefits.detail: Eligible items paid entirely with the card in the US/covered territories: if the seller refuses a return within 90 days, up to US$300/item and US$1,000/account/calendar year, excluding original shipping. Item must be unused, undamaged and working; exclusions include jewellery, software and consumables. Notify within 90 days of purchase; requested documents and returned item normally within 30 days of the respective request.

benefits.title: Rental-car accident protection
benefits.detail: Eligible covered rental accidents: scheduled accidental death/dismemberment up to US$200,000/Cardmember or US$20,000/other eligible driver/passenger; accidental-injury treatment up to US$5,000/person. Shared US$300,000/accident aggregate. Only for eligible card-paid rentals, not general travel medical insurance. State provisions, authorization, timing and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Rental-car personal property
benefits.detail: Eligible personal-property theft/damage during a covered rental: up to US$1,000/eligible person and US$2,000/rental accident aggregate. Full eligible rental payment and driver/rental conditions required. Excess coverage, exclusions and state-specific provisions apply.

benefits.detail: Up to $200 per calendar year for eligible incidental fees charged by one selected qualifying airline.

benefits.title: lululemon credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$75/calendar quarter on eligible US lululemon retail stores (excluding outlets) and lululemon.com purchases; gift cards and excluded channels do not qualify.

benefits.title: CLEAR+ credit
benefits.detail: Up to $219 per calendar year toward an eligible CLEAR+ membership.

benefits.title: Oura Ring credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$200/calendar year for eligible Oura Ring purchases directly at ouraring.com; not a reimbursement for every Oura subscription or third-party purchase.

benefits.title: Walmart+ credit
benefits.detail: Pay for one auto-renewing monthly Walmart+ membership: up to US$12.95/month plus applicable tax; annual plans and Plus Up excluded.

benefits.title: Equinox credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$300/calendar year on eligible direct Equinox club membership or Equinox+ subscription payments. Membership/eligible-service restrictions apply; not a general fitness credit.

benefits.title: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.detail: Charge eligible application fee: Global Entry US$120 or TSA PreCheck up to US$85 through an official provider, once every four years under current issuer product terms. Not both credits in the same four-year period; application approval is independent. Manual one-time tracker must be reset only at your actual next eligibility date.

benefits.title: Venue concessions — 10% back, up to $250
benefits.detail: 10% back on qualifying food and beverage concessions at participating Amex Venue Collection venues, up to US$250 in statement credits per calendar year through December 31, 2026; the full US$250 takes US$2,500 of qualifying spend. One eligible Amex card per Card Member is added to the offer in the Amex account, so it is one shared offer, not a separate US$250 on every Amex card. Venue, payment and purchase exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Priority Pass Select
benefits.detail: Enroll eligible Platinum card for participating airport-lounge access; up to two accompanying guests complimentary where permitted. Restaurants and other non-lounge experiences are excluded; network capacity and local guest rules apply. Companion cards do not receive this membership.
benefits.valueNote: Priority Pass Prestige equivalent, US$469/yr

benefits.title: Hilton Honors Gold
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Hilton Honors Gold status.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status.

benefits.title: Leading Hotels of the World Sterling
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Leaders Club Sterling status under current Platinum terms.

benefits.title: Avis Preferred Plus
benefits.detail: Enrollment for complimentary Avis Preferred Plus status (U.S. and Canada residents, rentals in the contiguous U.S. and Canada).

benefits.title: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards
benefits.detail: Enrollment for eligible Hertz elite benefits under current Platinum terms.

benefits.title: National Emerald Club
benefits.detail: Enrollment for eligible National Emerald Club Executive benefits.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.detail: Global Lounge Collection: network-specific itineraries, guests, enrollment and capacity rules apply. Priority Pass Select requires enrollment; Delta Sky Club has a separate annual visit allotment; Centurion/Sidecar have separate entry/guest restrictions. Companion cards are not equivalent to paid Additional Platinum cards.

benefits.title: Centurion & Sidecar lounges
benefits.detail: Eligible Platinum, matching confirmed same-day boarding pass and ID; Centurion entry within three hours of departure, connecting entry within five hours, no arrival-only access. Sidecar entry within 90 minutes. US Platinum guests generally US$50/adult and US$30/age 2–17 at US locations; under 2 free. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks up to two complimentary guests through January 31 after the following year. Location fees differ; guests must share the flight; capacity terms apply.

benefits.title: Delta Sky Club — 10 annual visits
benefits.detail: US eligible basic/paid Additional Platinum: 10 visits each February 1–January 31, each covering eligible entries within 24 hours. Same-day Delta-operated flight or Delta-marketed WestJet (006 ticket); Main Basic/equivalent excluded. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks unlimited visits through January 31 of the year after the following year. After allotment, US$50/visit; guests US$50/person, eligible itinerary required. Three-hour departure rule; issuer/Delta layover timing differs—verify before a long connection.

benefits.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
benefits.detail: Eligible FHR bookings receive program benefits such as daily breakfast for two, property amenity, room upgrade when available and late checkout under current terms. From January 1, 2027, the statement credit needs a stay of 2 nights or more; the perks still apply on one-night stays.

benefits.title: The Hotel Collection
benefits.detail: Qualifying stays through The Hotel Collection receive current program benefits; minimum stay requirements apply.

benefits.title: Platinum Concierge
benefits.detail: Access to Platinum Concierge service for eligible requests.

benefits.title: Global Dining Access
benefits.detail: Access to eligible dining inventory and experiences through current Platinum dining programs.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences / ticket access
benefits.detail: Access to eligible presales, reserved tickets and cardmember experiences where offered.

benefits.title: Amex Offers
benefits.detail: Eligible targeted statement-credit or points offers may be available after enrollment; offers vary by account.

benefits.title: Premium Global Assist Hotline
benefits.detail: 24-hour emergency assistance when travelling more than 100 miles from home. Certain approved emergency medical evacuation/transport services may be arranged without charge under Premium Global Assist terms. Third-party service costs generally remain yours unless expressly covered; contact Amex for advance approval. This is not general emergency medical insurance.

benefits.title: Cruise Privileges Program
benefits.detail: Eligible cruise bookings through participating Amex Travel services can receive specified shipboard credits/amenities; cruise line, itinerary, cabin and booking rules apply. This is booking access, not an elite status grant.

benefits.title: Unlock unlimited Delta Sky Club visits
benefits.detail: US$75,000 eligible calendar-year card-account spend unlocks unlimited eligible Delta Sky Club visits for the rest of the current Medallion Year and the following Medallion Year; itinerary, ticket and guest rules remain. This is lounge access, not airline elite status.

benefits.title: Unlock complimentary Centurion guests
benefits.detail: US$75,000 eligible calendar-year account spend unlocks up to two complimentary guests per eligible Centurion visit, through January 31 of the year after the following year. Same-flight, age, location, Sidecar and capacity rules remain.

benefits.title: First Additional Platinum Card without annual fee
benefits.detail: First Additional Platinum Card annual fee US$0; subsequent Additional Platinum cards US$195 each. Companion cards have different benefits. Eligible Morgan Stanley relationship required.

benefits.title: Membership Rewards deposits with Morgan Stanley
benefits.detail: Eligible cardmembers may redeem points for deposits to an eligible Morgan Stanley/E*TRADE brokerage or bank account; issuer example 50,000 points = US$500. Account eligibility and current redemption terms apply.

benefits.title: Conditional Morgan Stanley engagement bonus
benefits.detail: Qualifying Platinum CashPlus clients holding this card may receive an US$895 Annual Engagement Bonus, subject to CashPlus eligibility, payment timing, account fees and exclusions. This is a separate brokerage relationship benefit, not an automatic Amex fee waiver.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation & interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Covered round-trip cancellation/interruption: up to US$10,000/trip and US$20,000/card/12 months for each coverage, excess of other benefits. Full common-carrier transport paid with card/allowed points or vouchers; only defined causes qualify, not any reason. Pre-existing conditions and supplier insolvency excluded. Notify insurer and supplier within required times; insurer notice 60 days, proof 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered round trip delayed more than 6 hours: up to US$500/trip, two claims/card/12 months, excess of other benefits. Pay full common-carrier transport with the card/allowed points or vouchers and additional expenses with that card. Weather, equipment failure, hijacking/terrorism or lost travel documents may qualify; known delays excluded. Notify within 60 days; proof within 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.detail: Prior month's eligible wireless bill paid with card: covered theft/damage including cracked screens, up to US$800/claim after US$50 deductible, two claims/account/12 months; excess of other insurance. Lost/mysteriously disappeared phones and cosmetic damage excluded. Theft police report within 48 hours; notify claim within 90 days/as soon as reasonably possible, written proof within 120 days.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible card-paid new purchases: 90 days against theft/accidental damage/loss; up to US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Natural-disaster sublimit US$500/event. Only eligible card payment is covered; item/event exclusions apply. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Extends eligible original manufacturer warranties of five years or less by up to one year, after the original warranty/service contract. Warranty must be valid in the US/DC/territories; up to eligible card payment, US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Exclusions apply; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible and normally submit proof within 60 days.

benefits.title: Return protection
benefits.detail: Eligible items paid entirely with the card in the US/covered territories: if the seller refuses a return within 90 days, up to US$300/item and US$1,000/account/calendar year, excluding original shipping. Item must be unused, undamaged and working; exclusions include jewellery, software and consumables. Notify within 90 days of purchase; requested documents and returned item normally within 30 days of the respective request.

benefits.title: Car rental loss & damage insurance
benefits.detail: Secondary theft/damage cover up to US$75,000/rental agreement, first 30 consecutive days. Reserve/pay the entire rental with the eligible card and decline CDW/similar cover. Australia, Italy, New Zealand, peer-to-peer rentals and excluded vehicles are not covered; no liability insurance. State provisions vary; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible, proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered loss/theft/damage: carry-on up to US$3,000, checked US$2,000, high-risk items US$1,000; combined US$3,000/person/trip. NY US$2,000/bag and US$10,000/trip aggregate. Full common-carrier fare paid with card/eligible Amex rewards; other-program redemptions excluded. Excess of other cover; eligible family covered. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Rental-car accident protection
benefits.detail: Eligible covered rental accidents: scheduled accidental death/dismemberment up to US$200,000/Cardmember or US$20,000/other eligible driver/passenger; accidental-injury treatment up to US$5,000/person. Shared US$300,000/accident aggregate. Only for eligible card-paid rentals, not general travel medical insurance. State provisions, authorization, timing and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Rental-car personal property
benefits.detail: Eligible personal-property theft/damage during a covered rental: up to US$1,000/eligible person and US$2,000/rental accident aggregate. Full eligible rental payment and driver/rental conditions required. Excess coverage, exclusions and state-specific provisions apply.

loungeAccess.title: Escape Lounges – The Centurion Studio Partner
loungeAccess.detail: Complimentary entry to U.S. Escape Lounges – The Centurion Studio Partner (part of the Amex Global Lounge Collection) with up to 2 complimentary guests; more guests buy a day pass. Show the Platinum Card, a same-day boarding pass on any airline and government ID; the name on the boarding pass must match the card and the flight must be booked with a U.S.-issued American Express Card. Some locations admit you only within 3 hours of departure (no limit on a layover); entry is subject to capacity.

Published summary limits are recorded; binding eligibility, exclusions, claim deadlines, New York restrictions and account-specific terms remain controlled by the Guide/certificate and issuer. The public guide is available at the linked source.

benefits.title: $250 credit for select Chase Travel hotels
benefits.detail: Automatic statement credits up to $250 through December 31, 2026 on prepaid “Pay Now” Chase Travel hotel stays of at least two nights at participating IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor or Pan Pacific properties. Qualifying purchases do not earn points; the credit must be available when the purchase posts and may be reversed for canceled/modified stays or account closure within 90 days.

benefits.title: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS fee credit
benefits.detail: One statement credit, up to $120, every four years after the first eligible application fee is charged to the card by the Authorizing Officer or an employee/authorized user. Only fees paid directly to the government or authorized enrollment providers qualify; third-party application services and other trusted-traveler programs are excluded. Credit generally posts within 1–2 billing cycles.

benefits.title: $500 credit for stays with The Edit
benefits.detail: Up to $500 in statement credits per calendar year, with a maximum $250 per transaction, for prepaid “Pay Now” stays of two nights or more booked through The Edit by Chase Travel. Starting January 1, 2027, an additional $500 becomes available (two additional $250 credits), raising the annual maximum to $1,000. Qualifying purchases do not earn points; Employee Cardmembers are not eligible for The Edit program benefits. Credit must be available at purchase and account open/not in default at fulfillment.

benefits.title: $100 Curated Gift Card Credit
benefits.detail: Automatic statement credits on eligible curated gift-card purchases made directly at giftcards.com/reservebusiness: up to $50 January–June and another $50 July–December, max $100 per calendar year through October 31, 2028. Purchases by the Authorizing Officer or employee/authorized user qualify; credit can take up to four weeks. The account must remain open and not in default; Chase may reverse credits for returns, cancellations or account closure within 90 days.

benefits.title: $200 Credit with Google Workspace
benefits.detail: Up to $200 in automatic statement credits each calendar year through December 31, 2027 for purchases made directly with Google Workspace by the Authorizing Officer or an employee/authorized user. Third-party purchases do not qualify. Credits are allocated to the year the transaction posts; subscription renewals do not qualify once the offer expires or is fully used. Account must remain open and not in default.

benefits.title: $400 Credit with ZipRecruiter
benefits.detail: Up to $200 in statement credits January–June and another $200 July–December, for a maximum $400 each calendar year through December 31, 2027, on purchases made directly at ZipRecruiter.com by the Authorizing Officer or an employee/authorized user. Credits can take up to four weeks, may be reversed after returns/cancellations or account closure within 90 days, and must be available at purchase. Subscription renewals cease qualifying once the offer expires or is fully used.

benefits.title: $120 in ride credits with Lyft
benefits.detail: The first eligible cardholder/employee/authorized user to add the card to Lyft receives one $10 credit each calendar month through September 30, 2027 (up to $120 annually) for qualifying rides in Standard, Extra Comfort, XL, Black or Black SUV modes. Credits are ride-subtotal only, expire monthly, cannot be combined with other Lyft credits, and exclude fees, taxes, tips, memberships and gift cards. The separate 5X Lyft earning rule is listed with earning rates.

benefits.title: $300 in DoorDash promos
benefits.detail: After activating the included DashPass membership, receive up to $25 per month: one $5 discount on a qualifying restaurant order plus two $10 discounts on separate qualifying non-restaurant orders. Discounts apply to order subtotal, not fees/taxes/tips, and unused amounts expire at month end. Use the card that activated DashPass at checkout; eligible merchants, minimum subtotals, U.S. availability and exclusions apply. Offer terms run through December 31, 2027.

benefits.title: $300 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.detail: Automatic statement credits up to $300 for eligible purchases in the travel category per account year. The account year starts on the account-open date and renews after each anniversary through the first statement date thereafter (12 monthly billing cycles). Credits are allocated by transaction posting year; merchant category coding and posting date affect eligibility. The credited portion of purchases does not earn points, and credits may be reversed for returns/cancellations or if the account closes within 90 days.

benefits.title: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
benefits.detail: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status for the Authorizing Officer through December 31, 2027. Activate by linking an IHG One Rewards account in Chase Benefits; allow up to three weeks. Status is not available to Employee Cardmembers, will not apply retroactively, and requires the card account to remain open and IHG membership in good standing. Present the IHG account number at booking/check-in; brand/region rules and availability apply.

benefits.title: Complimentary DashPass membership
benefits.detail: Activate by December 31, 2027 to receive at least 12 months of complimentary DashPass on both DoorDash and Caviar; all users on the account share the period that starts with the first activation. Add the card as the default payment method and use that card at checkout on eligible DashPass orders. Minimum subtotals, U.S. address, merchant/geographic availability, fees, taxes and DoorDash/Caviar terms apply. Advertised membership value is $120.
benefits.valueNote: Chase-stated DashPass value, $120/yr

benefits.title: Avis, Hertz and National car rental benefits
benefits.detail: Avis offers up to 30% off qualifying base rates at 5,000+ locations, automatic Preferred Plus enrollment, free weekend rentals and up to 10% off Select Series. Hertz offers savings, faster service, extra return hours on U.S. rentals and bonus points to enrolled Hertz Gold Plus Rewards members. National offers up to 25% off qualifying rentals at participating U.S., Canadian, Latin American and Caribbean locations, complimentary Emerald Club Executive membership, an eligible free weekend day and one-class upgrade. Rates, eligibility, locations and partner terms apply.

benefits.title: 24/7 dedicated support
benefits.detail: 24/7 support from advisors trained for travel and business needs.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.detail: You pay no foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Points Boost
benefits.detail: Through Chase Travel, points can be worth up to 2x for top-booked hotels (including The Edit) and flights with select airlines. The boosted value depends on the specific itinerary shown at checkout.

benefits.title: Visa Infinite Concierge
benefits.detail: 24/7 Visa Infinite Concierge for travel, dining and entertainment.

benefits.title: Sapphire Lounges + Priority Pass
benefits.detail: Complimentary access to Chase Sapphire Lounges by The Club with up to two guests and Priority Pass Select access to 1,300+ lounges worldwide with up to two guests; additional Priority Pass guests may be charged (currently $27 each), subject to lounge terms and capacity. Also access select Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges and Air Canada Cafés in the U.S., Canada and Europe with an eligible same-day departing boarding pass on a Star Alliance airline, plus one guest. Employee Cardmembers cannot use the lounge benefits themselves, but may enter as guests of the Primary Cardmember. Priority Pass membership is activated for the Authorizing Officer.
benefits.valueNote: Priority Pass Prestige equivalent, US$469/yr

benefits.title: The Edit hotel stay benefits
benefits.detail: Book an eligible property through The Edit by Chase Travel for per-room benefits based on double occupancy, which may include a $100 property credit, daily breakfast, complimentary Wi‑Fi, a welcome amenity, room upgrade and early check-in/late checkout. Some benefits depend on availability and vary by property. Chase advertises $550+ value for a two-night stay, based on average 2025 program-benefit values; actual value varies by property, availability and use. Employee Cardmembers are not eligible for The Edit program benefits.

benefits.title: Emergency evacuation & transportation
benefits.detail: Covers necessary emergency evacuation and transportation expenses up to $100,000, plus up to $15,000 to repatriate remains, on an eligible covered trip. At least part of the covered trip must be paid with the card and/or eligible rewards; covered trip must be 5–60 days and more than 100 miles from the traveler’s primary residence. Evacuation must be medically necessary and authorized and arranged in advance by the service provider; local first-responder transport and unauthorized costs are excluded. The service provider is not an insurer; this is not an insurance benefit.

benefits.title: Roadside assistance
benefits.detail: 24/7 roadside dispatch for towing, battery service, tire changes, lockout assistance or fuel delivery. Up to $50 per incident, four incidents per year; you pay charges above the allowance and any non-covered service. Availability and vehicle/access restrictions apply. This is not insurance.

benefits.title: Travel & emergency assistance
benefits.detail: 24/7 travel and emergency assistance can arrange medical and legal referrals, emergency transportation, translation and other help while traveling. The service provides referrals and assistance; you are responsible for the cost of goods or services you obtain.

benefits.title: Transfer points to airline and hotel partners
benefits.detail: Transfer Chase Ultimate Rewards points to participating airline and hotel loyalty programs at the card’s advertised 1:1 rate. Transfers are made in 1,000-point increments to eligible accounts belonging to the Authorizing Officer or an eligible company owner; transfers are final and program availability/terms apply.

benefits.title: Status and credits after $120,000 annual spend
benefits.detail: After $120,000 in calendar-year purchases, unlock for the remainder of that year and the following year: World of Hyatt Explorist, IHG Diamond Elite, Southwest A-List, up to $500 in Southwest flight credits through Chase Travel and up to $500 in The Shops at Chase credits. Loyalty-program linking/activation and program requirements apply.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation & interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Reimburses prepaid, non-refundable eligible trip costs up to $10,000 per covered traveler and $20,000 per trip when a covered reason causes a trip to be canceled or cut short. Covered costs include passenger fares, tours and hotels; eligibility, payment, covered-reason and claim conditions apply.

benefits.title: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.detail: Reimburses reasonable, unreimbursed expenses up to $500 per covered traveler when common-carrier travel is delayed more than six hours or requires an overnight stay. Covered expenses can include meals and lodging; eligible cause, travel payment, secondary coverage and claim conditions apply.

benefits.title: Baggage delay insurance
benefits.detail: Reimburses eligible essential personal-item purchases up to $100 per day, for up to five days, when checked baggage is delayed or misdirected by a common carrier for more than six hours after arrival. Report the delay to the carrier; coverage is secondary to other reimbursement and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.detail: Get up to $1,000 per claim in cell phone protection against covered theft or damage for cell phones listed on your monthly cell phone bill when you pay it with your eligible credit card. Maximum of 3 claims in a 12-month period with a $100 deductible per claim.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

benefits.title: Return protection
benefits.detail: You can be reimbursed for eligible items that the store won't accept within 90 days of purchase, up to $500 per item and up to $1,000 total per 12-month period.

benefits.title: Car rental loss & damage insurance
benefits.detail: Reimbursement up to $75,000 for theft or collision damage to eligible rental vehicles worldwide, for rentals up to 31 consecutive days. Pay the entire rental with the card and/or eligible rewards and decline the rental company’s collision damage waiver. In the U.S., coverage is primary for business rentals and secondary for personal rentals (primary if you have no other insurance); outside the U.S. it is primary where available. New York residents have the stated personal-auto-insurance limitation. It does not cover liability, injury, damage to other property or personal belongings; vehicle and claim exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Emergency medical and dental benefit
benefits.detail: Reimburses eligible emergency medical and dental expenses up to $2,500 per covered traveler per trip, subject to a $50 deductible. If hospitalization is followed by a physician-directed hotel recovery before returning home, up to an additional $75 per day for five days may be available. Covered trips must meet the Guide to Benefits’ duration, distance, payment and eligibility rules; benefit is secondary to other valid insurance or reimbursement.

benefits.title: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.detail: Reimburses repair or replacement of checked or carry-on baggage and personal property inside it, up to $3,000 per covered traveler per trip. New York residents are limited to $2,000 per bag and $10,000 for all covered travelers per trip. Jewelry/watches and camera/electronics have separate $500 sublimits. Report loss to the carrier; reimbursement is secondary to the carrier and other recovery. Covered-trip payment and claim requirements apply.

benefits.title: Travel accident insurance
benefits.detail: Accidental death or dismemberment coverage up to $100,000 for 24-hour travel accident coverage and up to $1,000,000 for common-carrier travel per covered traveler. All or part of the common-carrier fare must be charged to the covered account and/or paid with eligible rewards; covered travelers need not travel with the cardmember. Trip duration, covered-loss definitions, exclusions and account-wide maximums apply.

benefits.title: Lost luggage reimbursement

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.detail: Up to US$800 per claim and US$1,000 per covered card per 12 months, maximum two claims, US$50 deductible. Pay the eligible monthly wireless bill with the covered card; coverage is excess of other insurance.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Purchase Assurance covers eligible items against covered theft or damage within the guide’s covered period; up to US$10,000 per loss and US$50,000 per covered card per 12 months. Coverage is secondary and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Doubles eligible manufacturer warranties for covered purchases, subject to the guide’s warranty-length and claim limits; up to US$10,000 per claim. Coverage and exclusions in the linked guide apply.

benefits.title: Car rental loss & damage insurance

The rental must be primarily for business or outside the cardholder’s country of residence for primary coverage; otherwise it is secondary. The entire rental must be charged to the card/eligible rewards and optional collision waiver declined when coverage is secondary. Loss of use is limited to US$500; exclusions and territory limits apply.

benefits.title: Travel accident insurance
benefits.detail: Worldwide automatic travel accident insurance up to US$1,000,000 under the linked guide’s covered-trip, eligible-person, travel-ticket payment and exclusion terms.

benefits.title: Emergency medical & dental
benefits.detail: MasterAssist Medical Protection provides secondary emergency medical/dental coverage up to US$2,500 per covered individual with a US$50 deductible; emergency transportation/repatriation limits and eligibility rules are in the guide. Separate MasterAssist referral/arrangement services are not insurance and their costs are paid by the cardholder.

Promotional/goodwill and already rolled-over credits generally excluded; earlier credits are not retroactively extended.

benefits.title: Annual Worldwide Companion Pass at C$25,000
benefits.detail: Spend C$25,000 in eligible net purchases before each card anniversary/reset date to earn one companion pass after renewal; allow 8–10 weeks. Companion economy base fare C$99–C$599 by region, plus taxes/fees/surcharges; basic Cardmember buys an eligible paid fare and travels on the same itinerary. Pass valid to book for 12 months; card must remain open/in good standing.

benefits.title: Priority airport services at Toronto Pearson
benefits.detail: Eligible basic/paid supplementary cards: Pearson priority security, complimentary valet service (parking charges remain), and 15% off eligible Express/Daily Park and car-care services under current booking/payment rules. No-fee supplementary cards excluded; services subject to availability.

benefits.title: Emergency medical insurance
benefits.detail: Up to C$5 million/person/trip for eligible insured persons age 64 or under, first 15 consecutive days outside the home province; government health coverage required. 90-day pre-existing-condition stability rules apply. Contact Global Excel before treatment or a 20% cost share can apply under the certificate; file claims within 90 days of return.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation insurance
benefits.detail: Covered cancellation: up to C$1,500/person and C$3,000/trip aggregate for eligible non-refundable prepaid costs paid with the card/its rewards. Only eligible payment amounts covered; other loyalty-program redemptions excluded. Defined covered causes, 90-day pre-existing-condition stability and prompt supplier/assistance notification apply; claims within 90 days of return.

benefits.title: Trip interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Covered interruption: up to C$1,500/person and C$6,000/trip aggregate. Eligible out-of-pocket expenses C$100/person/day, C$1,000 aggregate. Some prepaid travel must be paid with card/its rewards; other-program redemptions excluded. Covered-cause, stability and assistance-authorization rules apply; claims within 90 days of return.

benefits.title: Flight delay insurance
benefits.detail: Covered missed connection, departure delay or denied boarding with no alternative for four hours: necessary living/sundry expenses. C$1,000 aggregate per occurrence shared with baggage-delay cover. Full airline fare must be charged to the card.

benefits.title: Delayed & lost baggage insurance
benefits.detail: Delay of checked baggage at the outbound destination for six hours: essentials, sharing C$1,000 with flight delay. Lost/stolen baggage has a separate C$1,000 aggregate occurrence limit, including C$300 jewellery/C$250 golf-club sublimits. Full fare payment required. Delay essentials must be purchased within four days and before baggage return.

benefits.title: Hotel/motel burglary insurance
benefits.detail: Up to C$1,000 per burglary occurrence for covered property loss/damage from accommodation-room burglary. Full accommodation cost must be charged to the card; forcible-entry evidence and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Rental car collision/loss damage insurance
benefits.detail: Primary covered theft/damage on eligible rentals no longer than 48 consecutive days, vehicle MSRP up to C$85,000 before taxes. Charge full rental and decline CDW/LDW where possible. No liability cover; vehicle, territory and rental exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Travel accident insurance
benefits.detail: Scheduled accidental death/dismemberment benefits up to C$500,000 per covered person on a covered common-carrier trip. Charge the fare to the card before injury; eligible spouse/dependent children under 23 are included. Loss must occur within 100 days of the accident; exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible new items paid in full with the card: 90-day accidental physical damage/theft protection, C$1,000/Cardmember/occurrence. Excess of other insurance; exclusions and claims-document requirements apply.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Eligible manufacturer warranties of five years or less extended by up to one year. Full card payment required; C$10,000/item and C$25,000/Cardmember/policy-year limits. Warranty-territory conditions and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Amex Offers
benefits.detail: Register for eligible targeted offers before spending; merchants, thresholds, expiry dates and reward types vary by account.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences and ticket access
benefits.detail: Access eligible Front Of The Line presale and reserved tickets, events and experiences; availability, payment and ticket terms apply.

benefits.title: Fraud protection and emergency card replacement
benefits.detail: Fraud protection requires reasonable care of account details and PIN and prompt notification of suspected misuse. Contact Amex for lost/stolen-card assistance and replacement.

benefits.title: Travel emergency assistance
benefits.detail: 24/7 out-of-town medical/legal referral and coordination services. This is not medical insurance; third-party expenses are your responsibility and services must be arranged/authorized by the assistance provider.

benefits.title: Link Aeroplan and keep points active
benefits.detail: Link your own Aeroplan number to the card and include it on eligible bookings. Airline benefits may take 72 hours to activate. Aeroplan points do not expire while you remain the eligible basic Cardmember and your Aeroplan account is in good standing.

benefits.title: Additional World of Hyatt points
benefits.detail: Link eligible Aeroplan and World of Hyatt accounts before purchase: two World of Hyatt bonus points/C$1 on eligible direct Hyatt purchases, separate from Aeroplan earnings. Basic Cardmember only; no retroactive points. Current linked-program terms run through June 30, 2029; accounts must be in good standing.

benefits.title: Avis President's Club status

benefits.title: Maple Leaf Lounge and Air Canada Café access
benefits.detail: Through January 11, 2027: eligible basic/paid supplementary Reserve Cardmember plus one guest at participating Maple Leaf Lounges/Air Canada Cafés in Canada/US with eligible same-day departing Air Canada/Star Alliance travel. No Signature Suites or third-party lounges; capacity and guest rules apply.

benefits.title: Annual Aeroplan spending bonus
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: 12,500 bonus Aeroplan points after C$125,000 eligible posted calendar-year spend, then 2,500 per additional C$25,000 up to C$400,000 total spend/40,000 bonus points. Basic member receives bonus; additional-card spend counts. Calendar reset, 2027 spend starts January 12; allow eight weeks.

benefits.title: World of Hyatt Discoverist and night credits
benefits.detail: Link accounts: Discoverist status, five tier-qualifying nights after linking and each later year by January 31, plus eligibility to register for two status challenges/calendar year. Basic Cardmember only; these are qualifying nights, not free hotel nights. Current partner terms and challenge requirements apply.

benefits.title: Toronto Pearson restaurant credit
benefits.detail: Register, then get C$30 back once per period (July 6 to September 30 and October 1 to December 31, 2026) after a single C$60+ purchase at a participating sit-down restaurant at Toronto Pearson.

cards.feeNote: Current annual fee C$599; eligible supplementary Reserve cards C$199 or no-fee limited-benefit cards. From January 12, 2027 annual fee billing: basic C$799, supplementary C$249, renamed Expense Card C$25. Foreign currency surcharge 2.5%.
cards.coverageNote: Current product benefits, September 2026 agreement, July 1, 2025 insurance and official January 2027 change terms reviewed November 4, 2026. New 2027 benefits are dated separately. Card and Aeroplan account must be eligible/in good standing; link the correct Aeroplan account and include it on bookings. Status qualification credits do not grant automatic Aeroplan Elite status. Insurance payment, Canadian-residency, exclusions and claim evidence requirements apply. NEXUS uses issuer-defined fixed four-year eligibility windows; its slider is manual because build 3's rolling-from-use timer cannot reproduce those windows. No mobile-device insurance is listed. Employee-misuse full terms were not publicly linked and remain unresolved.

benefits.title: NEXUS credit
benefits.detail: Up to C$100/account for eligible NEXUS application/renewal fees in each issuer-defined four-year window, shared by basic/supplementary spend. New-card windows are anchored to the initial card anniversary; existing May 11, 2022 accounts use May 11–May 10 cycles. Rounded down to whole CAD; allow eight weeks. Track manually against Amex's fixed eligibility window.

benefits.title: Free first checked bag
benefits.detail: First checked bag up to 23kg/50lb for the eligible Cardmember and up to eight companions on the same reservation when checking in with Air Canada for an Air Canada/Rouge/Express-operated flight. Include the linked Aeroplan number; not extra baggage allowance on an already included bag. Supplementary eligibility follows the card tier.

benefits.title: Air Canada airport benefits
benefits.detail: Eligible basic and paid supplementary Reserve cardholders receive priority Air Canada check-in, boarding and baggage handling, with up to eight companions on the same reservation. Linked Aeroplan numbers and qualifying Air Canada/Rouge/Express flights required; no-fee supplementary cards lack these airline benefits.

benefits.title: Instacart credits
benefits.detail: Register in Amex Offers before purchase: two C$10 credits/month require two separate single-retailer Instacart Canada purchases of C$10 or more each. CAD and Canadian delivery required; gift cards, prescriptions, alcohol, international orders and listed Instacart programs excluded. Basic registered card only; through December 31, 2027, no rollover. Credit may take 150 days.

benefits.title: Priority Pass membership
benefits.detail: Enroll the basic Cardmember for Priority Pass membership; through January 11, 2027 all lounge visits/guests are paid at prevailing rates. Supplementary/no-fee cards do not get this membership. Same-day boarding pass, participating-lounge and guest rules apply.

benefits.title: 15% off eligible Air Canada flight rewards
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: 15% fewer points on the base fare of eligible Air Canada flight rewards, compared with a non-cardholder's same itinerary. An entire outbound or inbound origin–destination journey must be operated by Air Canada/Rouge/Express. Log in and book through Air Canada; mixed-operated journeys may not qualify. Taxes/cash charges are not reduced.

benefits.title: Fourth night free on Aeroplan hotel redemptions
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: each four consecutive hotel nights in one eligible Aeroplan hotel-portal booking paid entirely with points receive a reduction equal to the average points cost of one night. Cash/points bookings and combined separate reservations do not qualify; local/resort fees may remain payable.

benefits.title: Fourth day free on Aeroplan car rental redemptions
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: each four consecutive rental days in one eligible Aeroplan car-portal booking paid entirely with points receive a reduction equal to one day's average points cost. Same vehicle/provider/reservation required; cash/points bookings excluded. Fuel, insurance and local fees may remain payable.

benefits.title: Air Canada AC Wallet flight credit
benefits.detail: From January 15, 2027: basic Cardmember receives C$50 in AC Wallet January 15 and July 15, each expiring after six months. Aeroplan account must be linked at least 72 hours before issue. Use on a new direct Air Canada/Rouge/Express marketed-and-operated cash booking before expiry; not reward-ticket taxes, existing reservations or cash. Account closure cancels unused coupons.

benefits.title: Worldwide Maple Leaf Lounge access
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: eligible basic/paid supplementary cardholders plus one guest receive access to participating Maple Leaf Lounges and Air Canada Cafés worldwide with eligible same-day departing Air Canada/Star Alliance travel. Signature Suites and third-party lounges excluded; space, itinerary and entry rules apply.

benefits.title: Priority security at select airports
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: priority security where available when checking in with Air Canada for Air Canada/Rouge/Express-operated travel; eligible Cardmember and up to eight companions on the same reservation. Linked matching Aeroplan number required.

benefits.title: Two Priority Pass visits; up to six with spend
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: enroll for two basic-cardholder passes/calendar year. C$25,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks four more in that year and four in the next, maximum six/year. Guests use passes; maximum one guest/visit; unused passes expire December 31. 2027 qualifying spend starts January 12; allow up to 12 weeks to issue earned passes.
benefits.valueNote: 2 Priority Pass visits a year: cheapest public plan (Standard)

cards.coverageNote: Reviewed Chase Sapphire Reserve Visa Infinite Guide to Benefits effective June 11, 2026, linked from the issuer product page. The current public guide supplies the coverage limits summarized here; account-specific eligibility and later amendments remain controlling.

benefits.title: $250 credit for select Chase Travel hotels
benefits.detail: Up to $250 in statement credits through December 31, 2026 on prepaid Chase Travel hotel bookings at participating IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor or Pan Pacific properties. Two-night minimum; qualifying purchases earn no points.

benefits.title: $300 Annual Dining Credit
benefits.detail: Up to $150 in statement credits January–June and another $150 July–December, maximum $300 per calendar year, for dining purchases identified by Chase as made directly at restaurants participating in Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables. Third-party delivery/payment platforms, gift cards and merchandise may not qualify; restaurant participation and transaction coding can change.

benefits.title: $500 credit for stays with The Edit
benefits.detail: Up to $500 in automatic statement credits per calendar year for prepaid “Pay Now” stays booked through The Edit, with a maximum of $250 per qualifying purchase and a two-night minimum. The cardmember or an authorized user must pay with the card. Purchases that receive the credit do not earn points; credits can be reversed for canceled/returned/modified stays or if the account closes within 90 days. Account must be open and not in default when the credit is fulfilled.

benefits.title: Annual travel credit
benefits.detail: Automatic statement credits for eligible purchases in the travel category, up to $300 per account year. The account year starts on the account-open date and renews after each anniversary through the first statement date thereafter (12 monthly billing cycles). The credited portion of qualifying purchases does not earn points; merchant category coding and posting date affect eligibility.

benefits.title: Up to $420 in DoorDash promos
benefits.detail: After activating the complimentary DashPass membership, get up to $35 per calendar month: one $15 promotion on a qualifying DoorDash order and two separate $10 promotions on qualifying non-restaurant orders (such as groceries or daily essentials). Each applies to order subtotal, not fees/tax/tip; unused value expires monthly and the two $10 offers require separate orders. Use the card that activated DashPass at checkout; offer and merchant exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS fee credit
benefits.detail: One statement credit every four years, up to $120, after the first eligible Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee is charged directly to the card by the cardmember or an authorized user. Third-party application services are excluded; only one program fee is reimbursed per four-year period.

benefits.title: $10 monthly Lyft ride credit
benefits.detail: Add an eligible Reserve card to the Lyft app to receive one $10 in-app credit each calendar month through September 30, 2027 (up to $120 annually). Credit applies to qualifying rideshare ride modes; it is non-transferable, does not roll over, and may not combine with other Lyft credits. The separate 5X total-points offer on eligible Lyft purchases through September 30, 2027 is tracked in the earning rules.

benefits.title: $120 Peloton membership credits + 10X points
benefits.detail: After one-time activation, receive up to $10 per month in statement credits on eligible Peloton memberships, up to $120 per calendar year through December 31, 2027. Enroll/link the card with Peloton; third-party app-store subscriptions and purchases outside the U.S. are excluded. Separately, earn 10X total points (9X bonus plus 1X base) on eligible Peloton equipment/accessories bought directly from Peloton for over $150, through December 31, 2027, on up to $5,000 in total purchases.

benefits.title: $300 StubHub and viagogo credit
benefits.detail: One-time activation required. Up to $150 in statement credits January–June and another $150 July–December, maximum $300 per calendar year through December 31, 2027, for eligible event-ticket purchases made directly on StubHub.com, the StubHub app, viagogo.com or the viagogo app. Gift cards and StubHub International/UK purchases are excluded; credits do not roll over and may take up to four weeks to post.

benefits.title: Apple TV and Apple Music subscriptions
benefits.detail: Activate each offer once through Chase.com or the Chase Mobile app by June 22, 2027 and link an Apple Account. The primary cardmember receives at least 12 months of complimentary Apple TV and Apple Music from activation (advertised combined value $324/year). Eligible existing direct Apple subscriptions are suspended during the offer; Apple One subscribers may receive a $7.50 monthly discount per activated service. Card must remain eligible; one offer per Apple Account.
benefits.valueNote: Chase-stated value, $324/yr

benefits.title: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
benefits.detail: Complimentary Platinum Elite status through December 31, 2027 for the primary cardmember after linking an IHG One Rewards account through Chase Benefits. Allow up to three weeks for activation; account must remain open and in good standing, and IHG account must remain in good standing. Status benefits vary by brand/region and availability.

benefits.title: Complimentary DashPass membership
benefits.detail: Activate by December 31, 2029 to receive complimentary DashPass on DoorDash and Caviar until December 31, 2029 or for 12 months, whichever is longer (advertised value $120/year). Add the Reserve card to the app and use the same card at checkout; eligible orders receive $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees, subject to minimum subtotals, merchant/geographic availability and DoorDash terms. All users on the account share the activation period.
benefits.valueNote: Chase-stated DashPass value, $120/yr

benefits.title: Points Boost
benefits.detail: Through Chase Travel, points can be worth up to 2x on thousands of select top-booked hotels (including The Edit) and premium-cabin flights with select airlines. Boosted value varies by itinerary and is shown before booking.

benefits.title: Premium rental-car program benefits
benefits.detail: Access select partner benefits: Avis Preferred Plus enrollment and qualifying rate discounts, Hertz Gold Plus Rewards privileges, and National Emerald Club Executive membership with eligible upgrade/weekend benefits. Enrollment, rental rate, location and program terms vary.

benefits.title: Reserve Travel Designers
benefits.detail: Personalized itinerary planning and booking service for eligible primary cardmembers, advertised at up to $300 per trip. No agency fee is charged for bookings through the program, but suppliers may charge their own fees; travel, pricing and availability are subject to supplier terms.

benefits.title: Roadside assistance
benefits.detail: Tow, battery assistance, tire change, locksmith or gas, covered up to $50 per incident 4 times a year.
